summary: This directory provides specialized collection data structures designed for efficient data grouping and retrieval. It focuses on extending standard collection types to support complex mappings and keyed data storage within the shared utility layer.
responsibilities: Provide efficient mechanisms for mapping and retrieving grouped data
Ensure consistent behavior across the application for shared data management
relationships: Multi-map structures organize data by mapping keys to multiple values to simplify complex data retrieval.
Collection data structures provide the foundational mechanism for grouping information in a structured format.
designDecisions: Use of specialized data structures to optimize data organization
Implementation of consistent interfaces for collection-based operations
Encapsulation of collection logic to promote reusability across the codebase
